page.overview:
Who is Cave Spider?

Cave spiders are small variants of the spider that inflict Poison with their attacks. They are exclusively spawned by monster spawners found in mineshafts.

Cave spiders spawn from monster spawners in mineshafts at a light level of 0. These monster spawners are surrounded by cobwebs in corridors of mineshafts.

Cave spiders inherit their behavior from spiders:

They have some distinctions from regular spiders:
